column2: Please enter your login credentials before opening the shared payroll folder.
column3: 請在開啟共用薪資資料夾之前輸入您的登入憑據。
column5: credential 像 cre-den-tial，想成「可靠的人才有的證明」

column2: The purchase cannot proceed without written authorization from the finance director.
column3: 沒有財務總監的書面授權，這筆採購無法進行。
column5: author 作者說了算，authorization 就是有權的人點頭

column2: Only the plant manager can authorize overtime for the night shift.
column3: 只有廠長能核准夜班的加班。
column5: author 作者有權決定，後面加 ize 就是「給人權力」

column2: Troubleshooting took three hours because the printer error message was unclear.
column3: 由於印表機的錯誤訊息不清楚，故障排除花了三小時。
column5: trouble 麻煩 + shoot 射擊：把麻煩一槍射掉

column2: Our technician will troubleshoot the network problem as soon as he arrives.
column3: 我們的技術人員一到就會排除網路問題。
column5: trouble 麻煩 + shoot 射擊：對準麻煩開槍

column2: A system outage kept customers from placing orders for most of the morning.
column3: 系統中斷讓顧客整個上午大部分時間都無法下單。
column4: a major system outage (嚴重系統中斷)
column5: out 出去 + age：電力和服務「跑出去」了，就停擺

column2: IT scheduled the maintenance window for Sunday at midnight, when few users are online.
column3: 資訊部把維護時段排在週日午夜，那時上線的使用者很少。
column4: schedule a maintenance window (安排維護時段)
column5: maintenance 維修 + window 時間窗：開一扇「修理小窗」

column2: Streaming video from five offices at once used up all of our available bandwidth.
column3: 五間辦公室同時串流影片，用光了我們所有可用的頻寬。
column5: band 帶子 + width 寬度：網路水管有多寬

column2: High latency made the video call freeze every few seconds.
column3: 高延遲讓視訊通話每隔幾秒就卡住一次。
column5: late 遲 + ncy：資料遲到了，畫面就慢半拍

column2: Always keep a backup of the client database before you update the software.
column3: 更新軟體之前，務必保留一份客戶資料庫的備份。
column5: back 後面 + up：在後面多留一份保險

column2: The technician restored the deleted spreadsheet from last night's data.
column3: 技術人員從昨晚的資料中還原了被刪除的試算表。
column5: re 重新 + store 儲存：重新把東西放回倉庫

column2: Automation has cut the time needed to process invoices from two days to ten minutes.
column3: 自動化把處理發票所需的時間從兩天縮短到十分鐘。
column5: auto 自己 + mation：機器自己動手，人不用忙

column2: We plan to automate the monthly sales report so no one types it by hand.
column3: 我們打算將月度銷售報告自動化，這樣就不用有人手動輸入。
column4: automate a process (使流程自動化)
column5: auto 自己 + mate 夥伴：機器是自動做事的好夥伴

column2: The company uses artificial intelligence to sort customer emails by topic.
column3: 公司利用人工智慧依主題將客戶電子郵件分類。
column4: artificial intelligence system (人工智慧系統)
column5: artificial 人造的 + intelligence 智慧，縮寫 AI 唸「A-I」
column7: ar - ti - fi - cial in - tel - li - gence

column2: Machine learning helps our online store suggest products that shoppers are likely to buy.
column3: 機器學習幫助我們的網路商店推薦顧客可能會買的商品。
column4: machine learning model (機器學習模型)
column5: machine 機器 + learning 學習：機器自己看資料變聰明

column2: The search algorithm decides which results appear first on the screen.
column3: 搜尋演算法決定哪些結果最先出現在螢幕上。
column5: 發音像「阿哥哩森」：阿哥照著步驟一步步算

column2: The new interface lets sales staff check inventory without opening three separate programs.
column3: 新介面讓業務人員不必開三個不同程式就能查看庫存。
column5: inter 之間 + face 面：人與機器碰面的那一面

column2: Customers prefer our app because it is user-friendly and needs no manual.
column3: 顧客偏愛我們的應用程式，因為它操作簡便，不需要說明書。
column5: user 使用者 + friendly 友善：對使用者像朋友一樣親切

column2: Check the compatibility of this printer with our older laptops before ordering.
column3: 下單前請先確認這台印表機與我們舊筆電的相容性。
column5: com 一起 + pat 拍：兩樣東西能一起合拍
column7: com - pat - i - bil - i - ty

column2: IT will upgrade all office computers to the latest operating system next week.
column3: 資訊部下週會把所有辦公室電腦升級到最新的作業系統。
column5: up 向上 + grade 等級：等級往上升

column2: The airline downgraded his ticket to economy because the business class cabin was overbooked.
column3: 因為商務艙超賣，航空公司把他的機票降級為經濟艙。
column5: down 向下 + grade 等級：等級往下掉

column2: Install the security patch tonight to fix the vulnerability in the login page.
column3: 今晚請安裝安全性修補程式，以修復登入頁面的漏洞。
column4: a security patch (安全修補程式)
column5: patch 本是衣服上的補丁，軟體破洞也用補丁補

column2: Testers found a bug that made the checkout button stop working on mobile phones.
column3: 測試人員發現一個程式錯誤，讓結帳按鈕在手機上失效。
column4: fix a bug (修正程式錯誤)
column5: bug 原指小蟲，蟲子鑽進程式，程式就出錯

column2: The engineers showed a working prototype of the device at Monday's meeting.
column3: 工程師在週一的會議上展示了這項裝置可運作的原型。
column5: proto 最初 + type 型：最初的第一個樣子

column2: The firm holds a patent on the battery design, so rivals cannot copy it.
column3: 這家公司擁有該電池設計的專利，所以對手不能仿製。
column5: patent 像「怕疼」：怕別人抄，趕快申請保護

column2: The software uses proprietary technology, so other companies are not allowed to modify it.
column3: 這套軟體使用專有技術，所以其他公司不得修改。
column5: pro 前 + prie：同 property 財產，東西是我家的

column2: Our legal team protects the company's intellectual property by registering every new design.
column3: 我們的法務團隊透過註冊每一項新設計來保護公司的智慧財產權。
column4: protect intellectual property (保護智慧財產)
column5: intellectual 腦力的 + property 財產：腦袋生出的財產
column7: in - tel - lec - tu - al prop - er - ty

column2: The author owns the copyright to the manual, so you need her permission to reprint it.
column3: 作者擁有這本手冊的著作權，所以重印需要她的許可。
column5: copy 複製 + right 權利：能不能複製的權利

column2: We have trademarked the logo so that no competitor can use a similar symbol.
column3: 我們已註冊該標誌為商標，讓任何競爭者都不能使用類似的圖案。
column5: trade 買賣 + mark 記號：商品上的記號

column2: The lawsuit accuses the rival firm of patent infringement over its new camera lens.
column3: 這起訴訟指控對手公司的新相機鏡頭侵犯專利。
column5: in 進入 + fringe 邊緣：跨進別人的界線

column2: Copying the photographs without permission would infringe the photographer's copyright.
column3: 未經許可複製這些照片會侵犯攝影師的著作權。
column5: in 進入 + fringe 邊緣：越過別人的邊界

column2: Constant innovation is the reason our company keeps releasing popular new products.
column3: 不斷的創新是我們公司持續推出熱門新產品的原因。
column5: in 進入 + nova 新：把新東西帶進來

column2: She received an award for her innovative approach to reducing packaging waste.
column3: 她因減少包裝廢棄物的創新做法而獲獎。
column5: innovation 的形容詞，結尾 -ive 表示「有創新性的」

column2: As a leading innovator, the start-up introduced the first foldable laptop.
column3: 身為領先的創新者，這家新創公司推出了第一台可折疊筆電。
column4: a leading innovator (領先的創新者)
column5: innovate 創新 + or 人：創新的那個人

column2: Research and development receives twenty percent of the annual budget every year.
column3: 研究與開發部門每年獲得年度預算的百分之二十。
column4: research and development team (研發團隊)
column5: 縮寫 R&D：Research 研究 and Development 開發
column7: re - search and de - vel - op - ment

column2: The bank made a large investment in the new factory last year.
column3: 去年銀行對新工廠做了一筆大額投資。
column5: in 放進 + vest 衣服：把錢穿進公司身上
